correction: The companion CIO decision misstated the ratified Upbit liquidity floor as '24h traded value >= KRW 5B'. The ratified universe policy's KRW 5B floor is a 30-day average traded value. A CIO decision cannot introduce a new metric; the subscription/candidate floor must use the ratified 30-day average exactly as the universe policy defines it (fail-closed if unknown). Under that metric all 8 current markets pass; thin markets are handled by the user-ratified per-market freshness cap instead.
additional_cio_decision: Held positions: a market with an open PAPER position is always kept in the realtime subscription regardless of the floor, so exits remain possible; if its data is still stale, the ratified per-market HOLD + 30-minute alert applies.
